Verify that AI models and agent frameworks used in pipeline execution are sourced exclusively from approved registries with documented provenance.
Verify that model references are pinned by cryptographic digest (or equivalent) and unpinned references are blocked.

req_name: Risk Assessment and Allowlisting of External Model Endpoints
req_description: Verify that externally hosted model endpoints are subject to documented risk assessment and explicit allowlisting prior to use.
Verify that changes to model version are treated as pipeline changes subject to review and approval controls.
Verify that changes to model configuration are treated as pipeline changes subject to review and approval controls.

req_name: Agent Framework and SDK Version Change Control
req_description: Verify that changes to agent framework/SDK (Software Development Kit) versions are treated as pipeline changes subject to review and approval controls.

req_name: System Prompt Version Control and Review
req_description: Verify that system prompts used by pipeline-integrated agents are version-controlled and subject to peer review and change approval.

req_name: System Prompt Integrity Validation at Initialization
req_description: Verify that system prompt integrity is validated at agent initialization and execution is blocked on deviation from approved configuration.
Verify that system prompts do not contain embedded secrets, credentials, or sensitive organizational data.

req_name: System Prompt Version in Execution Provenance
req_description: Verify that the active system prompt version is captured in provenance records for each agent execution.

req_name: AIBOM Generation as a Release Artifact
req_description: Verify that an AIBOM (AI Bill of Materials) is generated for each pipeline-integrated AI system/agent prior to production release and stored as a release artifact.
Verify that the AIBOM (AI Bill of Materials) conforms to an approved machine-readable schema/format and non-conformant AIBOMs are rejected.
Verify that release is blocked when required AIBOM (AI Bill of Materials) fields are missing according to the documented completeness policy.
Verify that the AIBOM (AI Bill of Materials) includes model identifiers, versions, provenance/lineage, supplier/provider details, and integrity metadata for each model component.

req_name: AIBOM Dataset and Retrieval Source Fields
req_description: Verify that the AIBOM (AI Bill of Materials) includes dataset and retrieval-source identifiers, provenance, licensing/usage constraints, and update cadence where applicable.
Verify that the AIBOM (AI Bill of Materials) includes system prompt identifiers/versions and prompt configuration artifact references.
Verify that the AIBOM (AI Bill of Materials) includes agent frameworks, AI SDKs (Software Development Kits), client libraries, and toolchain dependency components.

Verify that the AIBOM (AI Bill of Materials) includes external endpoints used by agents, including model APIs (application programming interfaces), retrieval stores, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) and tool servers, with allowlist status recorded.

req_name: AIBOM Integrity Validation at Release Gate
req_description: Verify that the AIBOM (AI Bill of Materials) is integrity-protected (signed or equivalent) and signature/integrity validation occurs as part of the release gate.

Verify that AIBOM (AI Bill of Materials) generation is automated such that relevant changes in models, datasets, prompts, retrieval sources, tool servers, frameworks, or endpoints produce an updated AIBOM (AI Bill of Materials) in the same CI/CD (continuous integration/continuous delivery) workflow.

Verify that user access entitlements to pipeline systems, including version control, continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platforms, artifact registries, and secret stores, are reviewed on a documented cadence.
Verify that access logs are maintained and reviewed periodically.
Verify that privileged access management is implemented and monitored.
Verify that security policies for the production environment are enforced by an automated policy mechanism that blocks deployment and configuration changes that violate those policies.
Verify that production operational practices are reviewed against documented security policies on a defined cadence.

Verify that every software component running in production can be traced to a current, pinned SBOM generated by the build pipeline and validated before deployment, confirming nothing was installed outside the approved build process.

Verify that security patches for production pipeline infrastructure, including continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) servers, build agents, and runtime hosts, are applied within documented severity-based remediation timeframes.

req_name: Continuous Vulnerability Monitoring of Production Dependencies
req_description: Verify that third-party components in production software are continuously monitored against vulnerability feeds, and that newly disclosed vulnerabilities trigger remediation within organization-defined timeframes.

req_name: Real-Time Pipeline Monitoring and Anomaly Detection
req_description: Verify that real-time monitoring tools generate pipeline security logs and detect anomalies.
Verify that pipeline security logs are routinely reviewed and analyzed for anomalies not automatically detected.
Verify that pipeline security alerts are reviewed and responded to in a timely manner.
Verify that outbound network traffic from CI/CD runners is monitored, and that an alert fires when a connection goes to an unexpected or unauthorized destination.
Verify that only the specific processes that need it are allowed to query internal cloud metadata endpoints from a build agent, and that any other process doing so triggers an alert.

req_name: Cross-Process Memory Read Detection on Build Agents
req_description: Verify that one process reading another process's memory on a build agent is treated as abnormal and triggers an alert.

req_name: Publish Notification and Unexpected Release Investigation
req_description: Verify that publishing a new package version from an automated pipeline always sends a notification, and that any publish the team didn't expect gets investigated before it's trusted.

Verify that any workload appearing in a shared or system-level part of a runtime cluster is checked against an approved list, so anything deployed with stolen pipeline credentials gets caught quickly.
Verify that changes to CI/CD pipeline definitions, workflow files, and build configurations generate alerts and are logged with the identity of the actor who made the change.

Verify that developer endpoints generate alerts when an installed extension, add-on, or tool bundle produces anomalous behavior, including network egress from test runners or build tools, reads of credential files outside the user session context, or process activity inconsistent with the approved purpose of the tool.

Verify that prompt injection detection events are logged with full context including the input source, detected pattern or classification result, sanitization or blocking outcome, and the handling decision with rationale.

req_name: Agent Action Logging with Identity Context
req_description: Verify that agent actions are logged with identity context, permission scope, tool usage, and outcome.
Verify that secret access attempts by agents are logged.
Verify that outbound network destinations contacted by agent environments are logged.
Verify that agent activity logs are stored in tamper-evident or append-only systems with controlled access.

Verify that inter-agent communications including delegated instructions, sub-agent invocations, and inter-agent responses are logged as distinct events with sufficient context to reconstruct the full delegation chain.

Verify that agent tool invocations, including invocations of MCP (Model Context Protocol) and tool servers, are logged with sufficient detail to reconstruct the request and response for forensic purposes.

req_name: Human Approval for Irreversible Agent Operations
req_description: Verify that agents are prevented from performing irreversible high-impact operations without explicit out-of-band human approval.

req_name: Per-Identity Agent Rate Limits and Quotas
req_description: Verify that execution rate limits and action quotas are enforced per agent identity to prevent runaway automation.

req_name: Outbound Data Volume Monitoring for Agents
req_description: Verify that outbound data volume from agent execution environments is monitored and threshold violations generate alerts.
Verify that the maximum permission scope achievable by any agent or agent chain is enforced and cannot be expanded through agent-initiated requests.
Verify that agent credential usage is continuously reconciled against logged task scope and deviations generate alerts.

req_name: Data Classification Controls on Prompt Logs
req_description: Verify that prompt inputs and outputs are logged with data classification controls applied to prevent sensitive data from being written to insecure log targets.

req_name: Sensitive Data Exclusion from Agent Context
req_description: Verify that data classified as sensitive is technically excluded from agent context windows when not required for the assigned task and cannot appear in outputs transmitted to external endpoints.

req_name: Runtime Behavioral Anomaly Detection for Agents
req_description: Verify that runtime behavioral monitoring detects anomalous agent activity including unexpected tool invocation sequences, unusual data access patterns, and execution timing anomalies, and that detected anomalies generate alerts.

Verify that the deployed AI components (model version, prompt version, retrieval sources, tool servers, frameworks, endpoints) are reconciled against the approved AIBOM (AI Bill of Materials) and drift generates alerts.

req_name: AIBOM Retention for Audit and Forensics
req_description: Verify that AIBOM (AI Bill of Materials) records are retained and queryable for audits and forensics, including historical versions aligned to releases and deployments.

req_name: Continuous Vulnerability Monitoring of AIBOM Components
req_description: Verify that AIBOM (AI Bill of Materials) components including models, agent frameworks, SDKs (Software Development Kits), and tool servers are continuously monitored against vulnerability feeds and that identified vulnerabilities trigger remediation workflows or block execution depending on severity classification.
Verify that incident response plans are developed, maintained, and include procedures specific to pipeline security incidents.
Verify that incident response plans are tested regularly to ensure effectiveness.
Verify that pipeline recovery tests demonstrate recovery within the documented recovery time objective (RTO).
Verify that when a credential is rotated because of an incident, the compromised credential is revoked before the replacement is activated, and within a defined SLO.

req_name: Post-Incident Review of the AI Control Stack
req_description: Verify that post-incident reviews for AI agent compromise events include evaluation of whether prompt controls, tool allowlists, system prompts, AIBOM entries, and detection thresholds require updates, and that identified gaps are tracked to remediation.
Verify that incident response procedures include playbooks for AI agent compromise and prompt injection scenarios.

req_name: Agent Identity Suspension and Credential Rotation
req_description: Verify that response procedures can suspend agent identities and rotate associated credentials without requiring full pipeline shutdown.
Verify that forensic procedures preserve sufficient evidence of agent activity (inputs, tool calls, accessed data classes, outputs, downstream effects) with data classification controls.
Verify that agent compromise playbooks are exercised on a documented cadence and that gaps identified during exercises are tracked to remediation.
